name: Anvil's Echoes
description: The local forge engineer has lost his core hammer and needs your help.|He was calibrating gear on the coast when it vanished. Recover it and earn access to the smithing workstation.

text: Seeker, I've got a major problem.
My calibrated forge hammer was stolen.
Without it, production in this district is dead.
Help me recover it and I'll outfit you with proper forge gear.
Last ping came from the beach sector.
completedText: Please, go check out the beach for any clues.

text: Please, go check out the beach for any clues.
hasItemText: Take these forge boots as payment.
My station is open to you from now on.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You've been awarded @crimson@3000 Smithing experience@green@ and @crimson@Forge Gloves@green@.
